comment: Extremely clear, straight-forward. Just do the work and you can expect to learn a lot, along with a great score. One of the best professors in the department.

Prof K is a great professor. She'll tell you straight up what she expects from you and if you do what is asked, you should be fine. Do the extra credit that is assigned if you don't have a high interest in the class in case because it will help you with your grade! Participate in class even if you are not on-call. She expects you to be in class
